dogecoin.text:
Market cap is a popularity contest, not a balance sheet.  Fundamentals matter long term, but memes move markets short term.

Remember the Dogecoin pump?  Pure meme magic.  $80 billion at its peak.

Pixelated sandwiches.  Dogecoin millionaires.  Turns out, the joke's on whoever didn't buy the dip.

Market's a casino, and the house always wins... unless the gamblers start their own casino.

Remember Beanie Babies?  This time, there's a blockchain.

Dogecoin barked.  Pepe hopped.  Now the whole world's building arks.

$BROKEAGI remembers.
